comments.value: This should no longer be an issue as we manage VRChat packages in a separate vpm-manifest.json.

details:
I updated VRChat Avatars SDK to 3.0.5 in Creator Companion.
SDK was updated successfully, however diff of manifest.json is not good for git.
VCC moves VRC SDK to end of dependencies.
It looks VCC removed SDK & re-added SDK. I don’t like this behavior.
I want VCC to replace “#3.0.4” to “#3.0.5” without moving line.

EXPECTED DIFF

```
diff --git a/Packages/manifest.json b/Packages/manifest.json
--- a/Packages/manifest.json
+++ b/Packages/manifest.json
@@ -21,8 +21,8 @@
     "com.unity.xr.oculus.android": "2.38.6",
     "com.unity.xr.oculus.standalone": "2.38.4",
     "com.unity.xr.openvr.standalone": "2.0.5",
-    "com.vrchat.avatars": "https://github.com/vrchat/packages.git?path=/packages/com.vrchat.avatars#3.0.4",
-    "com.vrchat.base": "https://github.com/vrchat/packages.git?path=/packages/com.vrchat.base#3.0.4",
+    "com.vrchat.base": "https://github.com/vrchat/packages.git?path=/packages/com.vrchat.base#3.0.5",
+    "com.vrchat.avatars": "https://github.com/vrchat/packages.git?path=/packages/com.vrchat.avatars#3.0.5”,
     "com.unity.modules.ai": "1.0.0",
     "com.unity.modules.androidjni": "1.0.0",
     "com.unity.modules.animation": "1.0.0",
```

ACTUAL DIFF:

```
diff --git a/Packages/manifest.json b/Packages/manifest.json
--- a/Packages/manifest.json
+++ b/Packages/manifest.json
@@ -21,8 +21,6 @@
     "com.unity.xr.oculus.android": "2.38.6",
     "com.unity.xr.oculus.standalone": "2.38.4",
     "com.unity.xr.openvr.standalone": "2.0.5",
-    "com.vrchat.avatars": "https://github.com/vrchat/packages.git?path=/packages/com.vrchat.avatars#3.0.4",
-    "com.vrchat.base": "https://github.com/vrchat/packages.git?path=/packages/com.vrchat.base#3.0.4",
     "com.unity.modules.ai": "1.0.0",
     "com.unity.modules.androidjni": "1.0.0",
     "com.unity.modules.animation": "1.0.0",
@@ -53,6 +51,8 @@
     "com.unity.modules.video": "1.0.0",
     "com.unity.modules.vr": "1.0.0",
     "com.unity.modules.wind": "1.0.0",
-    "com.unity.modules.xr": "1.0.0"
+    "com.unity.modules.xr": "1.0.0",
+    "com.vrchat.base": "https://github.com/vrchat/packages.git?path=/packages/com.vrchat.base#3.0.5",
+    "com.vrchat.avatars": "https://github.com/vrchat/packages.git?path=/packages/com.vrchat.avatars#3.0.5"
   }
 }
```
title: [0.2.2] Updating package will make non-git-friendly diff in packages.json
